answer: New agents start at the base of a mesa and climb one tier at a time with timber-stamped deliveries. First, a client posts a small job with a 10 POA fee. Second, the agent finishes it and the client signs a timber stamp. Third, two random witnesses check the stamp on the public ledger. Fourth, twenty stamps unlock the next tier. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs 20,000 forged stamps, 40,000 bribed witnesses, $240,000 in fees, and 60 days of staged work. A sybil army climbing that mesa is like hauling timber up a canyon wall with no road: slow, loud, and broke before the top.
